title: Consent
subtitle: Who agreed to marketing on WhatsApp, who said stop, and the proof
forbiddenDescription: You don't have permission to view consent.
saveForbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.

overview.requireOn: Marketing goes only to people who opted in.
overview.requireOff: Marketing goes to everyone who hasn't opted out.
overview.emptyDescription: Changes appear here when someone replies STOP or START, staff record a consent, or you import opt-ins.

contact.title: Contact consent
contact.evidenceInPlaceholder: e.g. signed new patient form, 3 March 2026
contact.noHistory: Nothing recorded for this contact yet.
contact.readOnly: You can view consent but not record it.

import.title: Import opt-ins
import.description: A CSV with the columns phone, given_at (YYYY-MM-DD) and optionally note. Only people who agreed to marketing. Numbers that aren't contacts are skipped.
import.willApply: {n} will be recorded as opted in
import.evidence: Proof of consent for this file (required)
import.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. online newsletter sign-ups Jan–Mar 2026; form wording kept in practice records
import.nothing: Nothing to record from this file.

settings.title: Consent settings
settings.keywordsHelp: A message counts only when the whole message is the keyword (case and punctuation ignored).
settings.phrasesHelp: The exact titles of chatbot buttons that mean yes to marketing, e.g. “Yes, send me updates”.
settings.requireOptIn: Marketing only to people who opted in
settings.requireOptInHelp: Audiences leaves out contacts without a recorded opt-in when you use a marketing template. Lists pasted or imported straight into Campaigns aren't checked.
settings.serviceContinue: Keep sending service messages they asked for (appointment reminders)
settings.tipFooter: Put “Reply STOP to opt out” in the footer of every marketing template.
settings.tipChatbot: Add a chatbot keyword rule for the same words with no reply, so the chatbot doesn't answer a STOP as well.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.
